scope: Production native critic component: 40 steps, N64, B2048, fused Adam, IEEE FP32, fixed synthetic rollout and resumed checkpoint

publication_review.reviewer: Implementation review and independent CPU audit
publication_review.accepted_scope: Only production_shared versus native PyTorch; scratch register/cluster comparisons retained as diagnostic evidence.

normalization_scope: Updated once before burn-in, then frozen; every path consumes the same normalized 1,595 inputs.
timing_scope: Wrapper validation, packing and flush included. Restore, reference computation, all-state parity, diagnostic copies and clock queries excluded.
method: Three default warmups; wait 500 ms process-monitor quiet; alternate native/candidate order; monitor every 100 ms plus pair boundaries; exclude gaps over 350 ms; retain excluded pairs and require requested accepted pairs for every variant.
monitor_limit: Process-presence polling cannot prove absence between samples; only this process and named desktop services are allowed.
limitations: One GPU, one fixed synthetic rollout and five accepted pairs; no full camera or convergence claim.
CPU load and affinity were not controlled; process polling cannot exclude activity between samples.
The historical raw publication flag is preserved; this summary records acceptance for the stated scope.
